The nebula is a remnant of a star that has undergone a supernova explosion, leaving behind a glowing cloud of gas and dust. Setting: The background is a deep black, representing the vastness of space. Scattered throughout the background are numerous stars, varying in size and brightness, adding to the cosmic ambiance.
